title: Josiah knows about Max's mixtape and private beach motel

tellings.quote: stuff and Josiah wrote something about your music is being banded together you love your sacred time at the motel

plain: A boy named Josiah, one of the children in a documentary about kids said to read minds, wrote things about a man named Max Davis that he had no ordinary way of knowing: that Max's music was "being banded together," like a mixtape, and that he loves his "sacred time at the motel," a private beach motel on the Gulf of Mexico coast. Ky Dickens, who made the documentary, tells Michels this as a case of the telepathy she says these children have.
